focus: Overlay engine and doctor overlay commands: relayout, rollback, repin, json-entry merge, path and case handling in .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs and its callers.
noveltyJustification: 2 of 2 in-window findings are new; 4 further issues blamed to pre-v4.1.0.0 commits were recorded as observations, not findings.
keyQuestions: Does the overlay engine and its doctor commands (relayout, rollback, repin, json-entry merge, path and case handling) carry logic bugs in v4.2.0.0?
Where do the new v4.2.0.0 commands and hooks give operators bad UX: silent failures, misleading messages, unsafe defaults or dead ends?
ruledOut: rollback write-through a linked ancestor (lstat-based isDirectory)

graphEvents.label: Relayout backup has no restore command

label: repin --rollback refusal remedy (rollbackRun listRuns) prints 'rerun node .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs repin --rollback <run-id> from <root>'; the trailing 'from <root>' makes the pasted line a usage error (parseArguments returns null on unknown tokens) and diverges from nextEngine's 'Next: from <root>: <cmd>' form that in-window commit e7244e53648 made the rule. In window via 59d26c89f38.

A finished relayout writes relayout-runs/<stamp>/ (copied sources plus manifest, no backup.json) and prints only 'backup <label>', but no engine command restores it: COMMAND_WORDS has no relayout undo and repin --rollback reads only repin-runs/<id>/backup.json; undo is manual (copy sources back, restore manifest, re-point relinked layout links) and neither engine nor presentation contract names the steps. In window via 3aab896957e.
parseArguments matches any token whose slice(2) is upstream/to/stage/rollback as that flag (auto, onto, xxto act as --to); reproduced; blamed to 0bfe4d6e929, before v4.1.0.0
status/repin --json print plain text for usage errors and a non-directory root, against the catch block's own JSON comment; reproduced; blamed to f965c658d49, before v4.1.0.0

repin --rollback has no staleness guard: backup.json records only pre-run bytes and rollbackUnderLock checks backup integrity only, so rolling back an older run overwrites later work; inference, not executed; blamed to 0bfe4d6e929, before v4.1.0.0
relayout success line 'run node ... apply' lacks the from <root>: prefix; blamed to 3d39e6a488b, before v4.1.0.0, and the in-window sweep e7244e53648 left it unchanged

reason: isDirectory uses lstat so a link ancestor is unlinked, not followed
the route doc is narrower than the engine by design; the engine USAGE lists both
no defect found on read; heavily fixed in window and covered by archived M7
